scope: Independent source review and synthetic CPU tests of generated-measurement export, watched export execution, exact future-output packaging and multipart GitHub publication; not a full-run completion or physical-results audit

tests.command: NUMPY_MADVISE_HUGEPAGE=0 OMP_NUM_THREADS=8 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=8 .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_generated_export.py tests/test_generated_publication.py tests/test_generated_publisher.py

exporter: All five paths, four times, signed/negative/constant responses retained
Two paired seeds averaged within match before equal-match bootstrap; identical registered resampling draws
Effective-dose display retains fixed requested-dose groups; no regrouping or model fitting
Undefined ordering remains missing and does not count as success
Every response rejoins exact saved prediction artifacts; full passed audits required
CSV roundtrip and source/code hash rechecks
watcher: Requires owner-completed measurement-audit stage and exact audit hash
One wall-clock budget covers waiting and export execution
Failed supervisor stops new exports; SIGTERM records failure and cleans only owned export subprocess
Output directories remain immutable; no GPU exposure
packager: All registered420 or924 full-phase records, unique source/dose/seed identities and audit/cache bindings
Only frames[:,16:] and latents[:,8:] plus four native/edited feature arrays; no observed context/action/simulator-label arrays
Exact FP32 public slices, lossless NPZ, complete member and array readback
Safe relative member names and deterministic USTAR metadata
Actual padded part sizes bounded at1.8GB
Model attribution, license notices and exact registered source copies included
Packaging/helper hashes captured before work and rechecked when embedding and at completion
uploader: Complete package/part/sidecar agreement, unique records, summed part counts, local sizes/SHA256 and unchanged source bindings
Exact already-published commit, actual lightweight or recursively peeled annotated tag target checked before/final publication
No overwrite of conflicting remote assets; resumed request inputs must match
Every remote asset state, size and SHA256 verified and exact final asset set required
Uploader/helper hashes captured initially and rechecked before final pass

resolved_findings: Packaging/helper code was initially hashed too late; startup binding now enforced
Watcher originally left SIGTERM/timeout gaps; bounded owned-child cleanup now implemented
Release target metadata alone was insufficient; actual Git tag target is now resolved
Manifest unique IDs and total part record count now checked
limits: Synthetic tests do not replace each real phase generation/measurement audit or actual package readback
Remote GitHub requests/uploads were not executed by this review; tag resolution and remote conflicts were tested with fixtures
Published future-only clips omit evaluator observed-context inputs; exact frozen prediction reruns require authorized context access
Publication and successful execution do not establish generated physical accuracy or reliable physical control
